name: the spellplague
lore:
When the Blue Breath swept the Realms, nature itself forgot its shape. It was not merely the death of a goddess, but a fever that seized the world’s marrow. Great forests twisted into crystalline geometries, and the very earth took flight, birthing the floating motes that still haunt our horizons.

Beast and man alike fell to the "Spellscar," a malady of the soul. Predators developed strange, shimmering hungers, hunting not for meat, but for the residual hum of magic. Migratory birds flew in impossible patterns, guided by ley lines that had snapped like frayed silk. Even the weather grew sentient; storms of azure fire would hunt travelers with a predatory intellect. To walk the wilds then was to walk through a dream turning into a scream. Though the fires have dimmed, the world’s blood remains tainted by that chaotic blue light.
